access_links.label: FRS data download options (API, CSV, KMZ, map service)

description: The Facility Registry Service is the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency's integrated register of facilities and sites that are subject to environmental regulation or of environmental interest. It links each place's records across EPA programmes, such as air permits, water discharge permits, hazardous waste handlers, Risk Management Plan chemical facilities, the Toxics Release Inventory and Superfund sites, and shares them with governments, businesses, tribes and the public. Coverage is national, per facility with latitude and longitude where known. Access is free: a public REST API (JSON and XML), the Envirofacts API, an ArcGIS map service with programme layers, and prepackaged downloads updated monthly, namely a combined relational CSV set, a single flattened CSV and geospatial KMZ and CSV files for major and special-interest facilities, by state and nationally. Search of single facilities runs through the Enforcement and Compliance History Online site. As a U.S. Government work the data are in the public domain. Caveats: the public map service excludes sensitive data, emergency response services (ESF-10 and ESF-3) are intranet only, and coordinates vary in quality between programmes. For simulation it provides an asset inventory of industrial, chemical, waste and water facilities for hazard exposure, natech and interdependency studies. Related catalogue records include the Toxics Release Inventory and the European Industrial Emissions Portal.
